current_draft.content_markdown:
At DeepFest 2026 in Riyadh, BIOSTAR officially introduced its new [BIOSTAR EdgeComp](https://www.biostar.com.tw/app/en/news/news.php?S_ID=698) MS-NAT4000 compact Edge AI computing system, powered by the NVIDIA Jetson Thor platform. Designed specifically for industrial automation, robotics, and autonomous systems, the EdgeComp systems provide high-density AI performance, on-device Gen-AI capabilities, and real-time sensor processing at the edge. The launch highlights BIOSTAR's expansion into the robotics and autonomous sectors, offering hardware solutions that minimize latency and maximize decision-making speed in demanding environments such as smart manufacturing, smart cities, and smart retail.

## High-Density AI Performance

The systems are showcased at DeepFest Hall 5, Booth H5.C28, and Hall 3, Booth H3.C190-10, representing a significant leap in enabling next-generation industrial applications without relying on cloud connectivity. BIOSTAR showcased its EdgeComp MS-NAT4000 and MS-NAT5000 systems at DeepFest 2026. The systems are powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor and Orin platforms. They are designed for edge AI workloads in smart manufacturing, smart cities, and smart retail. The hardware supports real-time sensor processing and on-device Gen-AI for robotics and autonomous systems.
